name: University of Amsterdam
subjects: Social Sciences, Law, Humanities, Media, Psychology
note: Runs an 'independent student exchange (free mover)' programme. Tuition charged per course.

name: Eindhoven University of Technology
subjects: Engineering, Tech, Industrial Design, Natural Sciences
note: Accepts fee-paying free movers (pay tuition to TU/e); confirm the amount for your nationality.

name: Utrecht University
subjects: Humanities, Social Sciences, Law, Natural Sciences, Medicine
note: Accepts visiting students / free movers. Tuition charged per course (approx. EUR 875-1075 per 7.5 ECTS).

name: University of Amsterdam - Economics & Business
subjects: Business, Economics, Finance, Data Science
note: Economics & Business faculty free-mover option; fees charged per course.

name: University of Groningen
subjects: Arts, Social Sciences, Law, Science, Economics, Philosophy
note: Accepts free movers; tuition charged per course unit.

name: University of Helsinki
subjects: Social Sciences, Law, Medicine, Natural Sciences, Humanities
note: Visiting (free mover) students pay no tuition. Follow the exchange-student application periods.

name: University of Eastern Finland
subjects: Health Sciences, Forestry, Education, Social Sciences
note: Finnish public university - visiting students generally pay no tuition (confirm with the office).

name: University of Copenhagen
subjects: Social Sciences, Humanities, Natural Sciences, Health, Law
note: Guest / credit students. Free for EU/EEA students; non-EU pay tuition.

name: University of Vienna
subjects: Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Law, Business
note: Non-degree (free mover) admission for individual courses; low Austrian fees. Many courses in German.

name: LMU Munich
subjects: Humanities, Social Sciences, Natural Sciences, Law, Economics
note: German public university - no tuition, only ~EUR 150 semester fee. Many courses in German.

name: Trinity College Dublin
subjects: Arts, Humanities, Business, Engineering, Science, Law
note: Fee-paying Visiting Student route for EU & non-EU students (no exchange agreement needed).

name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
subjects: Engineering, Computer Science, Medicine, Business
note: Visiting / non-degree study available (confirm intake dates).

name: National Taiwan University
subjects: Business, Social Sciences, Engineering, Arts, Natural Sciences
note: Visiting Student Programme for non-degree students; two intakes per year.

name: Hanyang University
subjects: Business, Economics, Engineering, Social Science, Humanities, International Studies, Arts
note: Direct Visiting (Free Mover) programme; 1,000+ courses in English. Intakes in March & September.

name: Yonsei University
subjects: Business, Social Sciences, Engineering, Humanities, International Studies
note: Fee-paying Visiting Student Programme; 80% Yonsei tuition scholarship for all VSP students.

name: Waseda University
subjects: Liberal Arts, Social Sciences, Political Science, Economics, Science & Engineering
note: Fee-paying study abroad open to students from non-partner institutions; English-taught tracks (SILS).

name: National University of Singapore
subjects: Business, Engineering, Computing, Social Sciences, Sciences, Law
note: Fee-paying non-graduating (visiting) students accepted; exchange places are fee-waived.

name: University of Hong Kong
subjects: Business, Engineering, Social Sciences, Law, Science, Arts
note: Fee-paying Visiting Programme (non-exchange) - pay full tuition.

name: San Diego State University
subjects: Business, Marketing, Communication, Sports Management
note: Fee-paying 'Semester at SDSU' study-abroad open to international students.

name: University of British Columbia
subjects: Business, Engineering, Arts, Science, Forestry, Computing
note: Non-degree visiting students admitted for a session; international tuition rates apply.

name: University of Auckland
subjects: Business, Engineering, Arts, Architecture, Medicine, Law, Science
note: Study Abroad (fee-paying) programme; flat semester fee covering up to four courses.

name: University of Sydney
subjects: Business, Arts, Engineering, Health, Science, Law
note: Fee-paying Study Abroad (non-exchange) - pay tuition directly to Sydney.

name: Stellenbosch University
subjects: Arts, Business, Engineering, Science, Social Sciences, Law
note: Accepts fee-paying study-abroad students twice a year (Jan-Jun, Jul-Nov).

name: University of Cape Town
subjects: Business, Engineering, Humanities, Science, Health, Law
note: Semester Study Abroad (fee-paying); approx. USD 8,310 per semester. Requires a solid B average.
